AUDUN JOHNSON, PARTY WHO AFFECTED SERVICE ON DEFENDANT TESTIFIES ON BEHALF OF PLAINTIFF REGARDING HIS PROCES OF SERVICE. COURT DEEMS THAT SERVICE IS PROPER. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF FINER, REBECCA KATHERINE RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT SHAKOORI, SHABAN $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,090.00, THE LEASE TERMS WERE NOT APPROVED BY THE PLAINTIFF, THERE WAS NO MEETING OF THE MINDS.
